email.common.expiresInMinutes.context: How long an emailed link stays valid, e.g. in the password reset email; {count} is a number of minutes

email.passwordReset.subject.context: Password reset email subject; {tenantName} is the institute name

email.passwordReset.body.source:
Hi,

We received a request to reset your password at {tenantName}. Choose a new one here:

{link}

This link can be used once and expires in {expiresIn}. If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email - your password won't change.
email.passwordReset.body.context: Password reset email body (plain text). Keep {link} on its own line. {tenantName} is the institute name; {expiresIn} is a duration such as '60 minutes'
